## Lisbon 5-Day Trip Plan
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/map.svg

A balanced Lisbon plan for 2 adults, built around museums, walkable neighborhoods, one day trip, and budget-friendly seafood.
Trip window: **2026-04-10 to 2026-04-15** with one lighter arrival/departure day included in the cost split.

## Day-by-Day Lisbon Itinerary and Budget
| Day | Focus | Main Route | Est. Daily Cost | Travel Time Between Activities | Rainy-Day Backup |
|---|---|---|---:|---|---|
| Day 1 | Baixa + Chiado + riverside | Praça do Comércio → Rua Augusta/Chiado → Cais do Sodré | EUR 210 | 10–15 min walks; 15 min tram/metro segments | Museu Nacional de Arte Contemporânea |
| Day 2 | Alfama + history | Sé Cathedral → Alfama lanes → Castelo area → Miradouro stops | EUR 205 | 5–20 min uphill walks; 10 min tram rides | Museu do Fado |
| Day 3 | Belém museums + waterfront | Jerónimos → MAAT/Coach Museum area → riverside walk | EUR 240 | 10–20 min tram/bus; 15 min walks | Museu Nacional dos Coches |
| Day 4 | Sintra day trip | Lisbon → Sintra → Quinta da Regaleira / palace area → return | EUR 360 | 35–45 min train each way; 10–20 min local walks/bus | National Palace of Sintra |
| Day 5 | Bairro Alto + Príncipe Real + departure-day flexibility | Príncipe Real → São Pedro de Alcântara → Bairro Alto | EUR 185 | 10–15 min walks; 10 min tram/metro | National Museum of Contemporary Art |

## Lisbon Day Plan with Costs, Timing, and Backup Options

### Day 1: Baixa, Chiado, and the River
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
- Morning: Arrive, settle in, and start at **Praça do Comércio**; easy flat walking to **Rua Augusta** and **Rossio**. Travel time: **10–15 min** between stops.
- Afternoon: Explore **Chiado** and **Carmo area**; add a café break and a short ride to **Cais do Sodré**. Travel time: **10–15 min** on foot, **10 min** by metro/train connection if needed.
- Evening: Casual seafood dinner near the river, then sunset walk along the waterfront.
- Food: **Arroz de marisco**, grilled sardines, or a simple seafood rice lunch menu.
- Estimated cost for 2: **EUR 210**
  - Meals: EUR 80
  - Local transport: EUR 12
  - Sights/entry: EUR 18
  - Snacks/coffee: EUR 20
  - Buffer: EUR 80
- Rainy-day backup: **Museu Nacional de Arte Contemporânea** and nearby covered cafés.

### Day 2: Alfama and Lisbon Viewpoints
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- Morning: Start at **Sé Cathedral** and walk through **Alfama** lanes toward **Miradouro de Santa Luzia**. Travel time: **5–15 min** between spots; expect uphill walking.
- Afternoon: Visit **Castelo area** or choose a slower neighborhood loop with tram rides and photo stops. Travel time: **10–20 min** on foot; **10 min** by tram if you skip steep sections.
- Evening: Fado dinner or a relaxed tascas-style meal in Alfama.
- Food: Look for **grilled dourada**, octopus salad, or clams with bread.
- Estimated cost for 2: **EUR 205**
  - Meals: EUR 85
  - Local transport: EUR 10
  - Sights/entry: EUR 20
  - Snacks/coffee: EUR 20
  - Buffer: EUR 70
- Rainy-day backup: **Museu do Fado** for music and local history.

### Day 3: Belém Museums and Waterfront Walk
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/water.svg
- Morning: Go to **Belém** for **Jerónimos Monastery** area and a pastry stop. Travel time: **15–20 min** by tram/bus from central Lisbon.
- Afternoon: Choose one main museum cluster, such as **MAAT** or the **Coach Museum**, then walk the riverfront. Travel time: **10–20 min** between sights.
- Evening: Return to central Lisbon for a low-cost seafood dinner.
- Food: **Bacalhau** dishes, grilled fish, or a shared seafood platter if portions are generous.
- Estimated cost for 2: **EUR 240**
  - Meals: EUR 90
  - Local transport: EUR 14
  - Sights/entry: EUR 46
  - Snacks/coffee: EUR 20
  - Buffer: EUR 70
- Rainy-day backup: **Museu Nacional dos Coches** and nearby indoor café time.

### Day 4: Sintra Day Trip
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/train-front.svg
- Morning: Take an early train from Lisbon to **Sintra**. Travel time: **35–45 min** each way.
- Afternoon: Focus on **Quinta da Regaleira** or one palace plus the historic center; use local bus/taxi only if needed to save energy. Travel time: **10–20 min** between sites.
- Evening: Return to Lisbon and keep dinner simple near your hotel.
- Food: Budget for a light lunch in Sintra and a seafood dinner back in Lisbon.
- Estimated cost for 2: **EUR 360**
  - Meals: EUR 100
  - Train/local transport: EUR 40
  - Sights/entry: EUR 90
  - Snacks/coffee: EUR 20
  - Buffer: EUR 110
- Rainy-day backup: **National Palace of Sintra** and the old town core, which are easier to manage in wet weather.
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/0/06/Palacio_Ajuda_Lisboa_5.JPG Alt=Rainy-day backup: **National Palace of Sintra** and the old town core, which are easier to manage in wet weather, Lisbon, Portugal

### Day 5: Príncipe Real, Bairro Alto, and a Flexible Final Day
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/tree.svg
- Morning: Walk **Príncipe Real** and nearby viewpoints; keep it relaxed for shopping and café time. Travel time: **10–15 min** between stops.
- Afternoon: Continue to **São Pedro de Alcântara** and the edge of **Bairro Alto** for neighborhood wandering. Travel time: **10 min** on foot.
- Evening: Final seafood meal, then pack and keep the night flexible for departure timing.
- Food: Try a value menu with **grilled fish**, soup, and vinho verde.
- Estimated cost for 2: **EUR 185**
  - Meals: EUR 80
  - Local transport: EUR 10
  - Sights/entry: EUR 15
  - Snacks/coffee: EUR 20
  - Buffer: EUR 60
- Rainy-day backup: **National Museum of Contemporary Art** for an easy indoor option.

## Budget Fit for 2 Adults
- Trip total planned: **EUR 1,200**
- Contingency buffer kept: **EUR 700**
- Budget cap: **EUR 1,900**
- Result: **Comfortably within budget**, with room for extra museum entries, nicer seafood dinners, or a taxi on steep days.
